rules.basis: The LXP hybrid sheets state the nominal AC power at unity power factor, in watts.
The SNA sheets state surge power without the time on the same line; a gap until the duration is read.
The LXP and SNA sheets state one battery current for charge and discharge, '110/110 A' or '250'; two equal figures read as one, and a bound is refused.
The LXP sheets state the PV input's maximum DC voltage, 550 V.

names: Max. DC short current (input A/ input B)
rules.basis: The LXP sheets state the short-circuit limit per input, '13.7A/ 13.7A', read as one per-input figure.
The LXP sheets state the most PV power the unit takes, in watts.
